answer: When an agent refers a new member, the referrer earns a referral income capped at twice their own cumulative earned income, with excess locked in a crystal reserve until the summit. An attacker creating 100 fake identities incurs a crystal reserve of 1,000 crystals per identity at the wharf, totaling 100,000 crystals, making the cost linear and prohibitive, while an honest agent earns and locks a maximum of 2,000 crystals.
